_comment: ウォーターフォールクエストの ドット絵（2026-10-20 tomy さんの 指定「もっと リッチな ドット絵の RPG 風に」）。生成は scripts/slides/gen_images.mjs と 同じ 手順（bridge 経由）で、場面ごとの refs を 使う。できた 絵は `node scripts/images/place_quest_pixel.mjs <PNG の フォルダ>` で 本物の ドット絵の 粗さに 直して public/img/quest/ に 置く。 背景は 第2章（お客さまの 会議室）が 絵柄の 見本。自分たちの 会社で する 工程（第6・7・8・10章）は 第1章（自分たちの 会社）を 見本に して、果物の 額を 描かせない（2026-10-21、第2章を 見本に すると スーパーの 果物の 額が 写った）。
style: 16-bit Japanese console RPG PIXEL ART, like a 1990s Super Famicom role-playing game. The whole picture is drawn on a strict square pixel grid: it is a small low-resolution image enlarged with nearest-neighbour scaling, so every art pixel is a crisp, hard-edged square block of exactly the same size. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients (shading only with flat colour steps and a little ordered dithering), no painterly brush texture, no photographic detail. Limited palette of about 32 colours with clear 1-pixel dark outlines on characters and objects. Bright, warm, friendly and kid-safe: a cheerful office-work RPG about building a software app, never a dark fantasy.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Screens, papers, whiteboards and signs are blank or show only simple pictures. No watermark, no signature, no speech balloons.
negative: Never: smooth vector illustration, 3D render, painterly or blurry rendering, anti-aliased edges, real company logos or brand marks, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, scary or violent mood, weapons, blood.

scenes.title: 第1章 社内ミーティング（自分たちの会社）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: this is OUR OWN small software company's office, where the team prepares before meeting the customer. A JRPG battle backdrop seen from the front: rows of desks with two computer monitors each along the back wall, office chairs, a whiteboard with simple boxes-and-arrows drawings, a bookshelf with programming books (blank spines), a coffee machine, potted plants, a big window with daylight. No people at all. The FLOOR in the middle-front of the picture is open and empty (a character sprite will be placed there).
scenes.output: Output: one LANDSCAPE pixel-art picture, 1536x1024 (wider than tall). Draw it at 256x170 art pixels and enlarge it exactly 6x, so each art pixel is a 6x6 block.

scenes.title: 工程の図（10段の滝）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: work flows DOWN step by step like a waterfall and never flows back up. A tall pixel-art landscape: one big waterfall that falls down a mountainside in exactly TEN separate stone steps (terraces), from a small spring at the very top to a calm blue pool at the very bottom. Each step is a flat grassy stone ledge that sticks out clearly, alternating slightly left and right, with the water pouring over the edge of each ledge onto the next one below. The ten ledges are evenly spaced from top to bottom and each one has an empty flat spot where a small marker can stand. Small pixel trees and flowers on the sides, blue sky with small clouds at the top. No people, no animals, no buildings.
scenes.output: Output: one PORTRAIT pixel-art picture, 1024x1536 (taller than wide). Draw it at 128x192 art pixels and enlarge it exactly 8x, so each art pixel is an 8x8 block.

scenes.title: アイコン4つ（予算・危険・体力・経験）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: four simple game icons that a student understands without words. A 2x2 grid of four separate icons with wide empty space between them: TOP-LEFT a stack of three shiny gold coins (money). TOP-RIGHT a small cute green bug with six legs and two antennae (a software bug). BOTTOM-LEFT a red heart (health). BOTTOM-RIGHT a yellow star with a white sparkle (experience). Each icon is big, bold and simple with a dark 1-pixel outline.
scenes.output: Output: one SQUARE pixel-art picture, 1024x1024. Draw it at 64x64 art pixels and enlarge it exactly 16x, so each art pixel is a 16x16 block. The whole background is ONE flat solid pure magenta colour (#FF00FF). No magenta or pink in the icons except the heart is pure red.
